entry_points.text: Debugfs setup returns dir after installing tunables; config seeds random binding group; benchmark builds bitmaps timing loops exiting non-success; pool alloc/free/DMA carve and return; firmware walk dispatches matches.

Grouping returns null for zero or failure else clamped array; glob/hex take pattern/subject and dest/source/count; logger takes severity, prefix, header, geometry, range and printable per row; iteration halts on first nonzero callback.

exports.text: Fault decision by bundle and size with flag and usercopy forms; debugfs and configfs setup creating dirs and binding groups.
Bitmap first, next, last, nth, random and clump searches with and/or/not combos and LE views; masked scans report size when empty or beyond, nth subtracts weights.
String to bool, int and long long plus four-word generator step.
Proportion init, destroy, period decay, local add, fraction, capped add and sync; per-CPU set clearing shards and batched folding on threshold.
Firmware type, length, header, identity, dispatch and array walk with CDAT wrapper; walk clamps length, checks header fit, matches ids, caps and counts with over-cap warn.
Pool create, chunk add, destroy, device lookup, devm create with duplicate reject and unwind, OF lookup with fallback, and lockless word and range bitmap set/clear failing on contention.

Pool translate, alloc with owner, DMA aligned/zeroing, free, iteration, containment, avail/size and strategy replace; sizes round to order skipping short, zero returns zero; first, aligned, fixed, order and best-fit with rollback retry.

Radix lookup, allocating lookup with spare, prealloc, recursive free, atomic detach and bidirectional peek with skip and sentinel; glob predicates via shared matcher; NUMA grouping plus single-mask fallback; validated hex decode and encode.

Hex single-line renderer and multi-line logger; width-specific popcounts; cyclic and bounded ID alloc, iteration, cursor next and replace; radix tag check; xarray fetch, install, spare recovery and release.

hazards.text: Spacing and likelihood race with torn reads; directory and diagnostics need successful setup never call on failed bundles.
Invalid when handler fails, length zero, null CDAT header, or no handler.
Destroy needs no bits set; release needs single-chunk containment with bits set; alloc forbids NMI some builds needing rollback; fixed warns misaligned.
Duplicate, allocation and lookup failures return null or errno pointers unwinding acquired resources.
Short output truncates preserving termination with differing printable/plain needs sizing from return; removed storage retry-marked with capacity checks, boundary reset and signed-max guard.

invariants.text: Fail requires countdown, likelihood, task marker, allowance, stack, budget, spacing and draw below likelihood; counter checks stack first then decrements to zero; stack 32-deep require/reject intervals empty require or disabled accepts; draws pin CPU borrowing state modulo 100 shifts 6/13 2/27 13/21 3/12 final 18/2/7/13 masks 4294967294/88/80/68; fail logs rate-limited consuming allowance unless unlimited.

Debugfs exposes likelihood, spacing, allowance, budget, verbosity, rate and task filter plus depth and intervals when filtered as owner RW regular files retaining parent; attrs use decimal newline base autodetect assigning on success reporting length else parse error sharing depth and hex store.

Clump returns size if none else aligns to 8 loading byte; random returns size if empty, sole pos if one, else uniform ranked; bool rejects null from leading char with two-char on/off else invalid; int narrows wide, wide handles minus with both-sign overflow.
Benchmark times sweeps for each search and zero-area scan on dense random then sparse bitmaps; init returns retryable error; length 4096*8*10 bits, sparse divisor 500.

Fraction clamps denominator positive and at most unity with denom one if both zero; period no-ops if events at most one decaying only below bound; reflect returns if current else locks rechecks shifting if lag fits else zeroing then publishing; PROP_BATCH 8*(1+log2(ncpus)).
Growth enlarges until offset fits prepending old root tagging depth CAS-publishing retrying on loss; descent shifts and masks installing missing child once reusing loser freeing spare returning leaf.

? single non-terminator, * arbitrary run trailing immediate success matching separators, [] ranges ! negation literal ] first, \ escape; decode two chars per byte validating else EINVAL, encode two ordered chars; tables list 16 ASCII symbols ascending.

Sorts nodes by CPUs assigning at least one group each proportionally clamping total with inactive sentinel; remainder to leading wrapping cursor filling sibling then node-local with cluster pass if fits; masks from possible CPUs intersecting membership snapshotting present once; records hold id with union count then groups.

Rows to 16/32 default 16 one row per call coercing bad grouping to single bytes deriving counts and suffix plain versus padded printable; counts use stated width fast equal portable wider from narrower; IDs add offset to base clamping maxima to signed max rejecting negative minima advancing hint.

Offsets from index bits shifted by depth masked to chunk with out-of-range to bounded empty following redirect extending maxima over spans; marks per slot aggregate to root bulk-initialized when free-tracking consolidating spans clearing before empty; chunk, span, granularity, ceilings and exhaustion/missing/oom distinct.

locks.text: Period uses irq mask with sequence write, reflect irqsave spin, fraction sequence retry; set holds irqsave spin, batched add protects only flush via cmpxchg retry or irq-masked update.
Insert under spin, traversal and queries under RCU read, bitmap CAS retry with rollback and same-chunk retry.

Radix lock-free via one-time loads, release CAS and exchange detach; range alloc holds irqsave lock releasing on all paths with alloc after release before retry; slots publish ordered reclaiming after grace clearing before slab return.

state_machines.text: Glob keeps latest star rewinding there advancing subject failing only at end or without star; peek skips missing spans recomputing position parking overflow at sentinel restarting past last from root.

Cursor has located, bounded empty, invalid, error and restart suppressing creation on error with spare enabling restart; topology expands, inserts, clears, collapses, shrinks then defers reclaim; bounded alloc searches free chunks ending success, exhaustion or release-retry disposing spares.

structs.text: Config pairs group with bundle via group and container conversion; type lists null-terminated name, mode 0644, owner and show/store from macro.
Discriminator common/HMAT/PRMT/CEDT/CDAT plus wrapper of header union pointer with discriminator selecting view.
Pool holds min order, chunk list, lock, strategy, data and name; chunk holds span, base, owner, avail and bitmap.

Cursor holds array, index, span, node, offset, spare, hook, reclaim and error; nodes hold shift, offset, occupancy, parent, array, slots, marks and links; arrays hold head and flags; IDs hold hint, base and tree or bitmap chunks.
